t: How the US Postal Service reads terrible handwriting

q.x: Tom Scott did a great video showing the last one in operation. They use totally unique keyboards with what is essentially a stenography system: [link]

desc:
At the Remote Encoding Center in Salt Lake City, keyers process 1.2 billion images of mail every year. It's a more difficult job than I thought.

Edited by Michelle Martin: https://www.youtube.com/@OnTheCrux
Thanks to Zack from JerryRigEverything for being the camera op: https://youtube.com/jerryrigeverything
